correctness.rationale: Odd multiplier reduction by 2-adic valuation is sound. On input run of ones, deficit e=k-1-r obeys e↦floor(e/2), so run lengths >=4 do not alter s2(kN)-s2(N) for k=3,5,7,9. Independent full enumeration of exactly 70 capped triples with a+c+b+2>=7 matches all five classes and initial least-success candidates, plus L=7..32 exact length enumeration. Sturdy exception a=c=1,b>=1 gives N=3(2^(L-2)-1) and the folding argument that multiples of 2^r-1 have at least r set bits excludes every multiplier, not just <=9. Count identities close to binom(L-2,2).
residual_risks: The 70-state certificate is tied to the four-one carry lemma; the infinite domain cannot be inferred from enumeration alone.
